title: Tim Harman Joins Korn Ferry as Senior Client Partner
summary: Tim Harman has joined the firm as a Senior Client Partner in the Consulting business.
body_markdown:
**San Francisco, September 23, 2026** – Korn Ferry (NYSE: KFY) today announced that Tim Harman has joined the firm as a Senior Client Partner in the Consulting business. He will be based in the firm's San Francisco office.


Harman brings more than 25 years of experience in executive coaching, assessment, leadership development, and talent management. He has advised CEOs and C-suite leaders on succession and has extensive experience helping leaders navigate critical transitions.


“Tim understands the unique challenges that come with leading at the very top of an organization and the decision-making that boards and CEOs face around leadership and succession,” said Jamen Graves, Global Leader of CEO & Enterprise Leadership Development, Korn Ferry. “His experience and relationships will help strengthen how we serve clients on executive development and talent strategies.”


Harman holds a Master of Science in Occupational Psychology from the University of Sheffield.


**About Korn Ferry**


Korn Ferry is a global consulting firm that powers performance. We unlock the potential in your people and unleash transformation across your business—synchronizing strategy, operations, and talent to accelerate performance, fuel growth, and inspire a legacy of change. That’s why the world’s most forward-thinking companies across every major industry turn to us—for a shared commitment to lasting impact and the bold ambition to *Be More Than* .


As the Official Talent & Organizational Consulting Partner of LA28, Korn Ferry is powering the nearly 5,000 people who power the Olympic Games—bringing in the right talent, building strong leaders, and shaping the structure and culture that will deliver an unforgettable experience for the world.
